versions.changelog:
Initial release: Complete guide for KET (A2 Key) exam and beginner English app development.

- Covers exam structure and all modules: Reading, Writing, Listening, and Speaking.
- Provides progressive learning paths for Pre-A1, A1, and A2 (KET) learners.
- Includes detailed recommendations on vocabulary, grammar, question types, and child-friendly design.
- Offers practical implementation tips, UX features (progress tracking, wrong answer book, encouragement feedback), and a developer checklist.
- Supports both English beginners and KET exam prep, with distinct learning modes.
